records.title: SBI VC Trade RLUSD product page — Ethereum support now, XRP Ledger planned
records.note: Official SBI VC Trade VCTRADE product page states the current supported network is Ethereum and XRP Ledger is planned for future support. Its FAQ says current deposits and withdrawals are Ethereum only. This is a direct correction to the earlier 'RLUSD network support unverified' limitation; current VCTRADE RLUSD distribution is not an XRPL route at capture.

records.title: SBI VC Trade supported blockchain networks for deposits and withdrawals
records.note: Official SBI VC Trade network table lists USDC on Ethereum and RLUSD on Ethereum. It also identifies several assets for which withdrawals are not supported; therefore the table must be read per asset and per direction. For RLUSD, the dedicated product page explicitly says Ethereum only today and XRPL is planned. No current VCTRADE XRPL stablecoin deposit/withdrawal route is established.
